Sliver theta of angular width R^{-1/2} and radial length R^{-1} has sigma~R^{-2} and lies in one canonical cap under every reading of thickness; it meets ~R^{1/2} small gamma caps. Rescaling xi'=R^{-1/2}zeta, s=s0+R^{-1}tau gives Ef=R^{-2}e^{iPhi0}I(a,b,c)+err with fixed I, I(0,0,0)=vol>0; continuity gives |Ef|>=c0R^{-2} on tube T_R of volume ~R^3 (verified numerically min|I|/vol=0.899 over coherence box; script re-ran successfully), so LHS>=cR^{-5/4} and T_R fits in B_R for small absolute c1. Per gamma, sigma(gamma cap theta)<=CR^{-5/2}, hence L_inf<=CR^{-5/2} and L^2(B_R)^2<=CR^{-3/2} by Plancherel in y per fixed t integrated over |t|<=CR; the weighted L^2(w) bound of the same order follows by the standard R-ball covering (uniform local bound summed against (1+|k|)^{-N}, N>4) plus the stated TT* kernel decay, repairing the draft's terse 'w<=1' phrase without changing the estimate. Interpolation L^4^4<=L_inf^2 L^2(w)^2 gives <=CR^{-13/8} per piece; summing ~R^{1/2} pieces gives RHS<=CR^{-11/8}; ratio>=cR^{1/8}>>R^{1/16}. Smoothing of 1_theta at scale <<R^{-1} preserves orders. Exponent arithmetic confirmed at R=2^8,2^16,2^24.
